[[Cerris]] is a [[necromancer]] [[boss]] hired by the [[White Mantle]] for the [[War in Kryta|war]] against the [[Shining Blade]], and is a member of the [[Peacekeeper]]s.

==Notes==
* There are a number of corpses near Cerris, allowing her to quickly generate large numbers of minions.
* She uses [[Verata's Gaze]] to steal minions and [[Aura of the Lich]] to exploit available corpses; unprepared [[minion master]]s can be ineffective.
* It can be difficult to reach Cerris because [[Lerita the Lewd]]'s mob of Peacekeepers will probably be in the way.
